fusions.name: Rote Quarter-Turn
fusions.desc: Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill gives one back. A cut that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Juggler's Cascade
fusions.desc: After a 0.5 second cast, looses 4 clubs at once, spread apart. Each club deals 12 damage and always crits.

fusions.name: Muscle Memory Loop
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after.

fusions.name: Again From the Top
fusions.desc: Once every 8 seconds, a strike that fails to crit is rolled again for a crit, and the second roll stands.
